title: Spicy Italian Sausage Risotto
description: A hearty and flavorful Italian-inspired dish featuring spicy sausage and creamy risotto. Perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Arborio rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup of chicken broth to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed, stirring constantly.
Repeat the process of adding the chicken broth in 1-cup increments, stirring constantly, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese and cooked sausage.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the risotto immediately, garnished with chopped parsley.
